newsitem.title: USA: Binks may close plant, affecting 360 jobs.
newsitem.headline: Binks may close plant, affecting 360 jobs.

text.p: Binks Manufacturing Co., a spray finishing and coating equipment manufacturer, said Wednesday it was considering closing a plant in Franklin Park, Ill., in a move that would affect about 360 workers.
The company, which announced a restructuring in October, said the plan was prompted by the need to cut costs, streamline product lines and focus on high technology coating equipment.
The Franklin Park, Ill.-based company said the plant's future would be discussed at a board meeting on Dec. 11.
In late October, the company said it planned to change its name to Binks-Sames Corp. to reflect the international strength of its Sames SA subsidiary, based in France.

"The strategic planning process has revealed the need to reduce manufacturing costs, consolidate operations and streamline our product line," said Chairman John Schornack. "Our Franklin Park facility is not the centre of our high technology product development or manufacturing efforts."
Binks' stock fell 25 cents to $26.625 on the American Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
